## Steps of a Hypothesis Test

**MBI**

1) Choose an alpha-level ($\alpha$) / decision boundary.  
   $\hookrightarrow 0 \le \alpha \le 1$  
   $\hookrightarrow \alpha \ge P_{H_0}(\text{Reject } H_0) \leftarrow \text{Type I error}$

2) Define a random data generating process. $\qquad H_A$.

3) Determine meaningful null hypothesis, $H_0$, and alt.,

4) Determine a test statistic, $T$ (which is a RV),

5) Derive/approximate distribution of $T$.

6) Decide whether or not to reject null, $H_0$.
